understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid and complete every level by activating each goal cell. A goal activates only when the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation all match the goal's requirements before stepping onto it.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, and reaching zero stamina costs a life before resetting stamina. Walls and blocked directions cannot be traversed. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. Stamina refills restore stamina, and completing all goals advances to the next level; losing all lives ends the game.
